completion_data.completion_summary: Anchored skill_link_artifacts' three cwd-relative paths on SKILL_REPO_ROOT and added a missing mkdir -p for specs/tmp in skill-base.sh; added an opt-in --task N filter to reconcile-artifacts.sh while keeping its default no-argument sweep byte-for-byte unchanged. memory_candidates.content: When a bash function inside a repo's core scripts hardcodes cwd-relative paths (e.g. 'specs/state.json') instead of an already-exported repo-root anchor variable, it silently no-ops (or errors on a missing intermediate directory) whenever invoked from a non-root working directory. The fix pattern is: anchor every path operand -- including redirect targets and the source arg to `mv` -- on the anchor variable, and add any missing `mkdir -p` for intermediate directories the redirects depend on (e.g. a tmp dir used for atomic jq round-trips) as the first statement before the first write.

Converting a bash `for arg in "$@"; do case "$arg" in ... esac; done` argument parser to accept a flag with a value (e.g. `--task N`) requires switching to `while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do case "$1" in ... shift [N]; done` -- the for-loop form iterates positional args by value and cannot consume/shift a following token, so a naive addition of a value-taking flag causes the flag's value to fall through to the catch-all and abort. Support both two-token (`--flag value`, shift 2) and single-token (`--flag=value`, shift 1) forms for compatibility.
